title: 第14章 新人的待遇
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

采访结束之后，陈周跟着工作人员重新往后台走，场馆里的灯光依旧明亮。

远处还能听见解说席复盘比赛的声音，以及观众退场时乱糟糟的讨论声。

系统界面的提示“菜鸟，你很好地完成了自己的首秀。不过，这仅仅只是开始。”浮现在他脑海，奖励更是让他心一下子跳快了不少。

终于来了。

说实话，他一直很好奇，这系统奖励到底是什么东西，战局推演，听名字就很玄。

他下意识想到了很多自己写过的小说里的场景，比如脑袋忽然一阵清凉，无数比赛画面涌入意识；或者像电影里那种，世界突然慢下来，地图理解瞬间暴涨。

眼前的透明系统界面已经刷新。

【奖励已发放。】

【能力：战局推演（初级）】

【效果说明：】

【宿主将获得基础级比赛节奏预测能力。】

【可通过地图信息、兵线状态、资源刷新时间、英雄动向，对局势进行初步推演。】

【当前等级：初级】

【当前增幅：5%】

然后，没了，什么都没发生，没有脑海清流，没有顿悟，连头都没晕一下。

陈周站在原地等了两秒，又等了两秒。

“……”他嘴角微微抽了一下：“就这？”

旁边工作人员看他停下脚步，还以为他怎么了：“Tree？”

“没事。”陈周轻咳了一声，重新往前走，心里多少还是有点失望。

他本来还以为会有那种电竞仙人模式一样的东西，结果系统居然只是静静给了个说明。

不过很快，他又重新冷静下来。

因为仔细想想，系统效果不夸张很正常，一个电竞系统，你指望它像玄幻或者仙侠里的系统本来就不正常。

想到这里，陈周轻轻吐了口气。“回去再研究吧……”

而就在这时，身后忽然有人重重拍了下他的肩膀。

Eimy。

“卧槽兄弟！”这位年轻打野到现在还没缓过来，脸都是红的：“你今天真特么神了！”

“那波上路反蹲你怎么想到的？！”

陈周被他拍得差点一个踉跄，还没说话。

旁边imp已经慢悠悠走了过来，嘴里叼着烟：“别一副没见过世面的样子。”

“赢个VG而已。”

话是这么说，可他看陈周的眼神，明显已经和赛前不一样了，职业选手其实很现实，你能赢，大家自然就会尊重你。

虽说在LGD的序列里，他还是比不上GodV，但至少不是随时可能消失的替补。

他的身份已经提高到，在一些场次可以拉上场试试看的奇兵。

今天也已经证明了，这只奇兵很管用。

另一边，MaRin也走了过来，韩国人明显听不懂他们在聊什么，但还是朝陈周点了点头。

“Goodgame.”

“Thankyou.”

陈周笑了笑。

而就在这时。

外面忽然传来一阵更大的喧闹声。

LGD队员准备出场馆了。

虹桥天地场馆外，夜风有点凉，门口依旧聚着不少粉丝。

此时的LPL还没有S8之后的夸张饭圈文化，但强队的人气已经很高了。

尤其LGD这种银河战舰，哪怕战绩烂成这样，依旧有很多人等在门口。

队员刚出来。

尖叫声立刻响了起来。

“Imp加油！！！”

“Marin加油！！”

“平队加油！！！”

声音一浪接一浪，闪光灯不停亮起。

Marin和imp的声音是最响的，两个都是世界冠军，前者顶着FMVP的光环，长得也算周正，后者则已经在LPL征战一年有余，展现出了毫无指摘的实力。

哪怕在LGD1胜8负的时间里，也没人会认为是imp菜了。

陈周跟在队伍后面，忽然有种很奇怪的感觉。

因为没人喊他，哪怕他是这场老干爹能拿下VG的功臣。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the interview, Chen Zhou followed the staff backstage. The lights in the venue were still bright.

In the distance, you can still hear the sound of the commentators reviewing the game, as well as the chaotic discussion of the audience as they leave the field.

The prompt on the system interface "Rookie, you have completed your debut well. However, this is just the beginning." appeared in his mind, and the reward made his heart beat a lot faster.

It's finally here.

To be honest, he has always been curious about what the rewards of this system are. The battle situation is deduced, and the name sounds very mysterious.

He subconsciously thought of many scenes in the novels he had written, such as a sudden chill in his head and countless game scenes flooding into his consciousness; or like in movies, where the world suddenly slowed down and his map understanding suddenly skyrocketed.

The transparent system interface in front of you has been refreshed.

[Rewards have been distributed.】

[Ability: Battle Situation Deduction (Elementary)]

[Effect description:]

[The host will gain basic level game rhythm prediction ability.】

[The situation can be preliminarily deduced through map information, troop line status, resource refresh time, and hero movements.】

[Current level: Elementary]

[Current increase: 5%]

Then, nothing happened, no clarity of mind, no epiphany, not even a dizzy spell.

Chen Zhou stood there and waited for two seconds, and then waited for another two seconds.

"..." The corner of his mouth twitched slightly: "That's it?"

The staff nearby saw him stop and thought something had happened to him: "Tree?"

"It's okay." Chen Zhou coughed lightly and walked forward again, still feeling a little disappointed.

He originally thought there would be something like the E-Sports Immortal Mode, but in the end the system just quietly gave an explanation.

But soon, he calmed down again.

Because if you think about it carefully, it is normal for the system effect to be not exaggerated. For an e-sports system, it is not normal for you to expect it to be like the system in fantasy or Xianxia.

Thinking of this, Chen Zhou let out a breath."Let's go back and study it again..."

At this moment, someone from behind suddenly tapped him heavily on the shoulder.

Eimy.

"Damn it, brother!" The young jungler has not recovered yet, his face is red: "You are so awesome today!"

"How did you come up with that wave of squatting on the road?!"

Chen Zhou almost staggered when he photographed him and did not speak.

The imp next to him had already walked over slowly, with a cigarette in his mouth: "Don't act like you haven't seen the world."

"Just win VG."

That's what he said, but the way he looked at Chen Zhou was obviously different from before the game. Professional players are actually very realistic. If you can win, everyone will naturally respect you.

Although he is still not as good as GodV in LGD's sequence, at least he is not a substitute who may disappear at any time.

His status has been improved to the point where he can be played as a surprise player in some games.

Today has proven that this strange weapon is very effective.

On the other side, MaRin also walked over. The Korean obviously didn't understand what they were talking about, but he still nodded towards Chen Zhou.

"Goodgame."

"Thank you."

Chen Zhou smiled.

And just then.

Suddenly there was a louder noise outside.

The LGD players are getting ready to leave the venue.

Outside the Hongqiao Tiandi Arena, the night breeze was a bit chilly, but there were still many fans gathered at the door.

At this time, the LPL does not yet have the exaggerated fandom culture after S8, but the popularity of strong teams is already very high.

Especially for galactic battleships like LGD, even with such a bad record, there are still many people waiting at the door.

The team members just came out.

The screams started immediately.

"Imp come on!!!"

"Come on Marin!!"

"Come on, even team!!!"

The sound came one after another, and the flashlight kept lighting up.

Marin and imp have the loudest voices. Both are world champions. The former has the halo of FMVP and is quite good-looking, while the latter has been competing in the LPL for more than a year and has shown unimpeachable strength.

Even when LGD had 1 win and 8 losses, no one would think it was an imp.

Chen Zhou followed the team and suddenly felt a very strange feeling.

Because no one calls him, even if he is the hero who can win VG.
